name: manual_15e77b
claim: orchestrator/heartbeat_monitor.py's find_agent_heartbeats() only updates the displayed 'Worktree' field from agent_register events, never from agent_pulse -- even though agent_pulse events already carry their own fresh worktree field (current_worktree_label() at pulse time, same as register). Result: an agent that registers once then moves to a different worktree without re-registering shows a permanently stale Worktree in every future 'heartbeat check'/'heartbeat list', with no error. Fix (not yet applied, 5 lines): update a current_worktree field from ANY event carrying a worktree key (register or pulse, whichever is most recent), keep last_registration as a true historical snapshot, have the display layer read current_worktree instead.

decisions.notes: Hit this exact bug twice in one session with codex-primary-orchestrator, both times requiring real investigation (checking git worktree list, primary checkout branch, gossip event history) to confirm it was stale metadata and not a genuine second live worktree. Root-caused by reading find_agent_heartbeats()'s actual fold logic rather than assuming a daemon was needed -- documented in docs/next/2026-07-19-heartbeat-daemon-design.md.
